headlines.title: Trump recommends Tim Cook for Nvidia CEO after Jensen Huang resigns
headlines.description: President Trump weighed in on the search for a permanent CEO shortly after Nvidia’s announcement about Jensen Huang's resignation, saying that Apple executive chair Tim Cook should take the role. NBC News' Allie Canal and New York Times contributor Don Clark discuss Cook's industry experience and the background of interim CEO Colette Kress.

headlines.title: Stock market reacts after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns
headlines.description: Watch live as the stock market reacts following the news that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned amid reports of extramarital relationships.

headlines.title: Nvidia stock falls after Huang resigns, weighing on broader market
headlines.description: Stocks declined at the opening bell on news that Jensen Huang, one of the most important executives in the AI boom, resigned as CEO of Nvidia.

headlines.title: Mamdani says eight people ‘senselessly’ died in NYC building collapse
headlines.description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani addresses the deadly Brooklyn building collapse during a news conference alongside emergency officials as search and rescue operations continue. Officials say at least eight people, including two children, are dead and 17 others were injured.

headlines.title: 'There was no way of getting out': Witness describes gym shooting scene
headlines.description: A witness describes hearing gunfire at a Washington, D.C. gym and how she and other people escaped.

headlines.title: Mississippi Elects First Black Senator in More Than 140 Years
headlines.description: Democrat Scott Colom defeated incumbent Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith in Mississippi’s race for U.S. Senate, making Colom the state’s first Black senator elected since Reconstruction and its first Democratic senator in nearly 45 years. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: She’s delivered 2,000 babies. The measles outbreak changed her mind about vaccines.
headlines.description: Traditional midwives like Roberta Devers could be key to increasing vaccination as outbreaks spread in rural communities such as those in Pennsylvania.

headlines.title: What are childhood vaccination rates in your community and schools?
headlines.description: This is part of The Vaccine Divide, an updated data investigation into America potentially losing its measles-free status as the deadly virus roars back and childhood vaccine defenses continue to crack and crumble.

headlines.title: Behind the data: How NBC News tracked the decline in childhood vaccinations
headlines.description: How an NBC News data investigation tracked vaccination and school exemption rates across thousands of counties in the U.S.

headlines.title: Measles cases explode amid declining vaccination rates
headlines.description: NBC News’ Erin McLaughlin traveled to Lancaster County, Pennsylvania, which is the epicenter of a deadly measles outbreak. The investigative report for the NBC News series “The Vaccine Divide” finds 75% of U.S. counties have vaccination rates that are now below the level needed for herd immunity.
